hero.subtitle: Smart team creation, score tracking, and comprehensive player management. The all-in-one platform that transforms how you organize and play volleyball.
features.heading: Everything You Need to
features.subheading: From planning events to tracking scores — everything your volleyball community needs, in one place.
features.smartTeams.title: Smart Team Generation
features.smartTeams.description: Balanced teams in one tap. The algorithm considers skill ratings, preferred positions, and team size to create fair matchups every time.
features.liveScore.title: Live Score Tracking
features.liveScore.description: Track set-by-set scores in real time — any team player can add or edit scores. Browse your full game archive with complete results.
features.clubs.title: Clubs, Events & RSVP
features.clubs.description: Create clubs, plan events with RSVP deadlines, manage members, and handle join requests. Real-time notifications keep everyone in the loop.
howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subheading: Get started in minutes with our simple, intuitive process.
howItWorks.step1.title: Start a Club
howItWorks.step1.description: Create your volleyball club in seconds. Share your Club ID so players can request to join — no app download required.
howItWorks.step2.title: Plan Events & RSVP
howItWorks.step2.description: Schedule practices, friendly matches, or league games. Players RSVP with a tap, and you can set deadlines to lock attendance.
howItWorks.step3.title: Generate Fair Teams
howItWorks.step3.description: One tap creates balanced teams based on skill ratings and preferred positions. Edit teams or add guest players on the fly.
howItWorks.step4.title: Track Scores & History
howItWorks.step4.description: Record set-by-set scores in real time. Any team player can add scores. Browse your full game archive anytime.
faqs.heading: FAQs
faqs.subheading: Find quick answers to how VolleySmart works — from creating Clubs and generating fair teams to tracking games and managing your players.
faqs.stillHaveQuestionsDescription: If you didn't find what you were looking for, you can browse all FAQs or reach out to us directly. We're happy to help.
cta.heading: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Plan events, generate fair teams, track scores, and manage your volleyball community — all for free.
